top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) is an invention whose original realisation, magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms, is clearly identifiable, independently reproduced at JILA, RIKEN, PTB, NIST and SYRTE, and opens experimentally verified new access to 10^-18 measurements. The two-name allocation fits the original work with only a narrow, statable note on Lemonde and Takamoto, and the citation can separate it from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes. P002 is excellent science but cannot be credited to the right people within a three-name limit (Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang are omitted) and its experimental half rests on one group. A prize is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no link to Katori, Ye, Kane, Mele or Molenkamp. Institutional proximity to Johansson at Chalmers is irrelevant to these proposals.
